description: Header file declaring the interface for the 'XBB' device driver related to Zigbee support. It includes include guards, licensing information, necessary includes, and a function prototype for initialization conditioned on the CONFIG_SERVICE_DEVICE_ZIGBEE macro.

methods.name: xbbDeviceDriverInitialize
methods.description: Function to initialize the XBB device driver, returning a pointer to a DeviceDriver object. It is only available if Zigbee support (CONFIG_SERVICE_DEVICE_ZIGBEE) is enabled.
